note: Everyone you can talk to. chats[0] is the first meeting, chats[1] the second (warm or cold depending on how the last chat went), chats[2] is every chat after that (lines rotate). Each reply: social (your Social stat), close (closeness with this person, 0-100), answer (what they say back). {you} is the player's name. Archetypes give the extra students a voice; their names come from extra_names.

zanele.name: Zanele
zanele.bio: O Block's loudest laugh. Borrows everything, returns it with interest.

lines: Did you eat? You look like you didn't eat.
